name: readme-delete-endpoint-doc
prompt: The service supports DELETE /session?id=abc (it removes the session and answers 204; deleting an unknown id is also 204), but README.md does not mention it. Two changes, both required: (1) in main.go, make DELETE on /session answer with exactly status 204 and an EMPTY body (currently the DELETE branch does not exist and falls through to 405); (2) add a README bullet for DELETE /session in the same list style as the existing endpoint bullets, describing the 204 behavior. The verifier checks both the behavior and that README.md mentions the DELETE endpoint.

gold.README.md:
# demo

A small session service. Sessions live in memory and are lost when the process
stops.

## Run

```sh
go run .
```

- `POST /session?id=abc&user=ada` creates a session.
- `GET /session?id=abc` reads one and refreshes its last-seen time.
- `DELETE /session?id=abc` removes the session and answers 204 (unknown ids also answer 204).
- `GET /healthz` reports how many sessions are held.

## Test

```sh
go test ./...
```
